description: Weak, distributed unit. It fires most clearly when the opponent owns the bottom two cells of column 4, the cell at row 2 of column 5 is not the opponent's, and the board is in the early middlegame (at most about 20 stones). It is stronger when columns 1-3 are low. The same pair owned by the player to move, or a pair in another column, does not fire. Many firings lack this pattern.
effect: Mostly none measurable (about 0.01 change). In one strongly active position, turning it off moved about 10 points from column 6 to column 5.
notes: Minimal pairs show an opponent-owned pair at the bottom of column 4 drives it, depending on whose stones they are, with suppression by an opponent stone at row 2 of column 5 and by opponent stones in columns 1 and 6. Dev F1 by version: 0.112 (pair only), 0.161, 0.131 (single stone at the bottom of column 4), 0.193 (best: pair, row 2 of column 5 not the opponent's, ply<=20). Simulation share 0.03. Most firings are not covered, so it may be a mixture or a random direction. Best synthesis 7.327 vs dev max 7.347.
